parameters.outer: one fixed RM(5,11) [2048,1024,64] constituent repeated 1024 times

probability_space.outer: fixed deterministic RM(5,11); no outer setup event
probability_space.routing: independent uniform 2048-coordinate permutation per row and uniform 1024-position permutation per transposed region
probability_space.inner: independent uniform binary 23-by-23 linear map at each of 2^21 RandomStepConv positions

claim.covered_range: every nonzero RM(5,11) shell below weight 128

scope: The bound sums every nonzero RM(5,11) weight shell below 128 with outward arithmetic.
The diagnostic supplies only tilt witnesses; the certificate does not require them to be optimal.
Weights 128 and above are not covered. This is not a complete occupation-one or minimum-distance certificate.
